description: Bottom-sheet picker for choosing a spending-alert threshold percentage. Slides up over a scrim on a glass surface; tapping an option persists immediately and dismisses. Replaces the bespoke inline Modal.

onSelect.description: Called with the chosen threshold; persists + auto-dismisses

onClose.description: Dismiss without change (close btn / Done / Android back)

layout.titleRow: 'Alert threshold — {budgetName}' (bodyBold/colors.text, numberOfLines 1) + close btn (close icon 24, colors.textMuted, 44pt)
layout.subtitle: 'Alert me when spending reaches:' (typography.small / colors.textMuted)
layout.optionGrid: wrap row, gap spacing.md, chip minWidth 30%, paddingVertical spacing.lg, radius.md
layout.doneCta: full-width gradients.primaryGradient, radius.md, paddingVertical spacing.md, white typography.button

accessibility.reducedMotion: present without slide (fade/immediate) when reduce-motion enabled
